notes.content:
[list]
[*] Introducing Scenarios - Play a predefined unit layout on Premium maps.
[*] Removed CP requirement for Premium content - All content avaliable without need for CP, but still respecting XP-tier system.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]
* Introducing Premiump Map - 'Desert Combat.' * Reduced CP cost of premium items. * General bug fixes. * General maintenance.

** Please perform a complete reinstall if updating from previous version. **

* Updated the menu system.
* Introducing player guidance system for Campaign Mode.
* Improvements and fixes to the AI.
* Introduced additional methods for tourmanent registration
* Unit movement bug fixes.
* General bug fixes.
* General maintenance.
